title: Johanan Saves the People and Ishmael Flees
description: Johanan son of Kareah, along with the army commanders, meets Ishmael at the great waters of Gibeon. The captives taken from Mizpah return to Johanan, while Ishmael escapes with eight men to the Ammonites. Johanan takes the people with him to Geruth-Kimham near Bethlehem, intending to go on to Egypt out of fear of the Chaldeans.
